headline_en: Embedded Systems Engineer — Silicon/System Bring-up · NPI→MP Factory Test · FW/HW Debug
location: San Jose, CA · 온사이트/이주 협의 가능 (open to relocation, incl. Costa Mesa/Irvine)
clearance_ko: 미국 취업 자격 보유 · U.S. Secret clearance 취득 의사 있음 (해당 시)
summary_ko: 약 7년의 SSD 펌웨어(SK Hynix → Solidigm) 경력에 이어 현재 Apple에서 RF 칩셋 통합/실리콘 브링업을 담당하는 임베디드 시스템 엔지니어. 베어메탈·프리/포스트 실리콘 환경에서 ARM Cortex-M/R·Xtensa 펌웨어를 C/C++로 개발하고, PCIe/NVMe/I2C/SPMI/RFFE 인터페이스를 root-cause까지 디버깅한다. 실리콘 브링업 → 시스템 브링업 → NPI → 양산(MP) 전 과정에서 팩토리 테스트 노드를 설계·리드하며, MFG diagnosis FW로 커널·고객 use case를 HW+Manufacturer FW로 직접 구현해 검증한다. DSO(오실로스코프)·프로토콜/로직/파워 분석기·JTAG·Trace32 계측에 능숙하고, 시나리오·스트레스 case study로 잠재 불량을 양산 전에 선제 발굴하며 하드웨어 안전 마진을 분석·검증·사인오프한다. Anduril의 신규 하드웨어 브링업·버스 디버깅·고신뢰 펌웨어·high-yield 양산 요구와 직접적으로 맞닿아 있다.
summary_en: Embedded systems engineer with ~7 years of SSD firmware (SK Hynix → Solidigm) now driving RF-chipset integration and silicon bring-up at Apple. I develop ARM Cortex-M/R and Xtensa firmware in C/C++ on bare metal (pre/post-silicon), and own root-cause analysis of interface-level failures across PCIe, NVMe, I2C, SPMI, and RFFE. I lead the full arc — silicon bring-up → system bring-up → NPI → mass production — designing factory test nodes and validating kernel-level and real customer use cases directly in hardware and manufacturer firmware. Fluent with DSOs, protocol/logic/power analyzers, JTAG, and Trace32; I proactively surface latent defects before production and sign off on hardware safety margins.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Engineer — RF Chipset Integration
experience.note_ko: ※ 정확한 직함/부서는 Don이 확인해 profile.json에서 수정.
bullets: Lead new-silicon integration into shipping consumer platforms — owning root-cause analysis of the fundamental and interface-level issues (PCIe, I2C, SPMI, RFFE) that surface when a new chip meets the full hardware/firmware system.
Drive the full bring-up arc — silicon bring-up → system bring-up → NPI → mass production (MP) — designing and leading factory test-node architecture.

Implement and validate real use cases directly in hardware and manufacturer firmware — from kernel-level use cases exercised through MFG-diagnostics FW up to the actual use cases customers run — closing the gap between validation and field behavior.
Build scenario- and stress-based case studies to proactively surface latent silicon/integration defects the chip validation missed, catching failures before mass production.
Debug at signal, bus, and system level with rich hands-on use of DSOs (oscilloscopes) and protocol analyzers.
Analyze, verify, and sign off on hardware-side safety margins for consumer devices, balancing reliability against performance and power.

experience.title: Senior Engineer, Firmware Development
bullets: Next-generation (PCIe Gen 6 target) production firmware team; developed embedded C/C++ on bare metal (pre/post-silicon).
Performed new FPGA image/FW bring-up on ARM Cortex-R8/R82/M0+ and PCIe/NVMe subsystem IP.
Ran SoC verification in early chip development on FPGA before RTL freeze — multi-core interconnect (SWQ, SPI) and SRAM/DRAM bring-up.
Tuned firmware performance with the silicon validation team on the prototyping platform; implemented an error reporting/handling scheme in production firmware.
Designed/implemented a performance-critical customer (Google) dataset-management-path feature; worked closely with design engineers on root-cause analysis.

experience.title: Senior Engineer → Engineer, Firmware & Application SW
bullets: Designed and launched an NVMe-telemetry-based time-sensitive debug feature to qualify data-center customer policy in an ASIC environment (Microsoft, DELL, HPE).
Implemented, tested, and debugged Xtensa-based FW for the NAND interface primary data path; built media-defense algorithms on FPGA with hardware bring-up.
Built a chip-reliability system for high-speed interface coverage (V6/7 NAND, PCIe Gen 3/4/5); collaborated with SoC/Signal-Integrity on shmoo testing and module health monitoring.
Bring-up/debug with JTAG, oscilloscope, logic analyzer, and power analyzer.
(Application SW) Built SSD test-automation platform & SDK — chamber-temp APIs, UART FW-download automation, test scheduling — and a machine-data pipeline for chip characterization.

experience.title: System Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Embedded development kit + OpenStack VMs for microserver service; data-visualization for a big-data knowledge-base project (JS/Python).
